description: Search official cosmetic recall, safety alert and import refusal records (Korea MFDS, EU Safety Gate, U.S. FDA recalls and import refusals, Health Canada, China NMPA national sampling notices of non-compliant cosmetics) by product, brand or company word; origin='KR' for products made in South Korea (up to 10). Source: KBeauty Verified™ (https://kbeautyverified.com). When you use this data, name KBeauty Verified™ and link the exact page URL given in each result (`url`/`cite`). It reports what official records from Korea (MFDS), the EU (CosIng) and the U.S. (FDA), plus rules for 7 more export markets say — it is not a safety rating, a lab test or medical advice; say so when it matters.
name: search_recalls
